name: Pokémon™ Ultra Sun
description:
Bonus until 10/01/2018:
Download code for 12 Quick Balls for Pokémon™ Ultra Sun for Nintendo 3DS.
The download code is valid until 30/11/2018.

Pokémon Ultra Sun and Pokémon Ultra Moon offer an alternative story taking place in the same world as Pokémon Sun and Pokémon Moon, as well as new Pokémon that didn’t appear in Pokémon Sun and Pokémon Moon. There will be additional elements to let you enjoy your adventure even more.

Ominous dark clouds are spreading in the sky above the Alola region, the setting of Pokémon Ultra Sun and Pokémon Ultra Moon. In these adventures, a story unfolds on a grand scale, with the Legendary Pokémon Solgaleo, Lunala, and Necrozma at its centre. Secrets about Necrozma and the Alola region – undisclosed in the previous games – will come to light.
disclaimer:
The dozen Quick Balls will be available as a gift in Pokémon Ultra Sun, and Pokémon Ultra Moon for players who have purchased the digital versions of the games.

Instructions on how to get the dozen Quick Balls can be found at https://www.pokemon-sunmoon.com/ultra/en-us/cool-features.html

Games in 2D. Some areas also playable in 3D.

Use Parental Controls to restrict 3D mode for children 6 and under.

Due to the size of this game, it may take longer to download the digital version of this title when compared to other Nintendo eShop games. At the time of purchase you can choose either “Download Now” to begin to download the game immediately or
“Download Later” to download the game when the system enters “Sleep Mode.”

You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
descriptors: Online Interactions Not Rated by the ESRB
